dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The dorsal fin displays a high density of non-uniform, high-luminance circular blobs. The largest and most concentrated clusters are located at the posterior base of the fin, with a gradient of decreasing spot size and spatial frequency toward the anterior edge and distal apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small concave notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the dorsal fin, approximately midway between the base and the apex.
